name: Complete a form accurately
short_description: Complete a 20-field administrative form from source information and detect any unavailable answer.
self_assessment: I can complete a 20-field form without help and flag every unavailable answer.
description: Complete a 20-field administrative form from source information and detect any unavailable answer. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
